newsitem.title: USA: Standard & Poor's to add Sybron to MidCap 400.
newsitem.headline: Standard & Poor's to add Sybron to MidCap 400.

text.p: Standard & Poor's Financial Information Services said it will replace Tambrands Inc in the MidCap 400 Index with Sybron International Corp, currently a component of the S&P SmallCap 600 Index.
It will replace the company after the close of trading on Monday, July 21.
Tambrands is being acquired by S&P 500 component Procter & Gamble Co in a cash transaction.
ICN Pharmaceuticals Inc will replace Sybron in the SmallCap 600 Index.
Standard & Poor said Sybron, which makes and sells laboratory and dental supply products, will be added to the S&P MidCap 400 Health Care (Medical Products & Supplies) industry group.

ICN Pharmaceuticals, which makes and sells prescription and over-the-counter drugs, diagnostics, and biotechnology research products, will be added to the S&P SmallCap 600 Health Care (Drugs-Generic & Other) industry group.
Standard & Poor's Financial Information Services, a division of McGraw-Hill Cos Inc, provides financial, economic, and investment information.
